Round glitter snow blanket tree skirt 100cm. It offers ample coverage to conceal tree stands, brackets, and cables .and is simple and easy to use.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Christmas Tree Skirt
- Discover Cozy & Festive Christmas Tree Skirts
- The hexagonal design creates a neat, structured tree base, while the distressed white finish adds rustic character to your Christmas display
- Made from wood, this decorative collar helps conceal the tree stand and creates a cleaner, more polished presentation
- The distressed white finish brings a rustic, farmhouse-inspired feel to traditional or contemporary Christmas decor
- The lightweight, collapsible construction is easy to handle and helps save storage space between Christmas seasons
- A practical alternative to a fabric tree skirt, it helps cover the tree base without shifting or wrinkling
- The distressed white finish brings a rustic, farmhouse-inspired feel to traditional or contemporary Christmas décor.
- The structured hexagonal shape provides a smart alternative to a traditional fabric tree skirt.
- Suitable for use with both artificial and real Christmas trees.
- Tool-free assembly makes setup simple, while the collapsible design folds flat for compact storage after the festive season.
- The fire-retardant design is suitable for use with Christmas lights and decorations when used responsibly.

## Information
Give your Christmas tree a neat, finished look with this wooden hexagon tree collar. Designed to sit around the base of the tree, it helps conceal the stand while adding rustic warmth to your festive décor. The burnt wood finish, decorative reindeer and Merry Christmas detailing create a traditional seasonal style. Made from sturdy wood, the collar is designed for repeated use across multiple Christmas seasons. It folds down for easier storage and assembles with latch hinges and small pins. Measuring 31.5 inches in bottom diameter, 26 inches in top diameter and 9.8 inches in height, it is suitable for larger tree stands. Fire-retardant construction supports safer use around Christmas lights and decorations. Not suitable for children under 36 months.
